question: Which of the following files is used for filing narrow grooves and angles above 10°?
solution:
The correct answer is __Knife-edge file**(Option 4)**.__

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• Knife-edge file__ is specifically designed for filing narrow grooves and angles above 10°.
 
• Its thin, sharp edge makes it suitable for precision work in tight spaces.
 
• It is commonly used in intricate engineering and crafting tasks where accuracy is critical.
 
• Other types of files, such as square, triangular, or half-round, are generally used for broader or differently shaped surfaces.

**__Additional Information__**

 
• **Square File:**
 
 
• Used for filing square grooves or rectangular slots.
 
• It has four flat surfaces and is ideal for corners and edges.
 
 
 
• **Triangular File:**
 
 
• Typically used for filing internal angles and for sharpening saw teeth.
 
• Its triangular cross-section makes it versatile for various tasks.
 
 
 
• **Half-Round File:**
 
 
• Combines flat and curved surfaces for filing concave and flat areas.
 
• Often used for general-purpose filing tasks.
